lens: evidence integrity, privacy, least-privilege browser capture, retention, and safe action

findings.observation: The local synthetic handoff records a browser-extension request locator and the reviewed message, but the backend intentionally replaces the source tab URL with the frozen fixture lineage.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-4/chrome/trace.json; capture a450e693-ad01-476f-8c42-5e33cdf4ee5d has source_locator browser-extension-request:web-local-4ec6b36f-38bd-4f54-ae2c-a6be69e0d57c and one exact m1 evidence item.
findings.user_impact: This is truthful for the synthetic integration fixture, but a future real-evidence implementation would need a governed, purpose-limited locator so a recruiter can distinguish source provenance without retaining unnecessary browsing data.
findings.recommendation: Before enabling non-synthetic capture, define a minimized source-locator contract and deletion behavior rather than reusing the fixture mapping.
findings.verification: A non-synthetic design review proves that the locator is source-specific, access-controlled, deletable, and does not expose unrelated browsing history.

strengths: The visible Chrome selected-text flow succeeded only after a user gesture; an unrelated tab denial proves the extension fails closed instead of broadening access.

The exact frozen sentence was visible before capture, the extension renders selected text as reviewed_text, and the localhost route rejects any payload that differs from the frozen TS-CORE-01 sentence.
A direct database and API-log comparison proves zero capture POSTs before Submit and exactly one capture POST after the user's explicit approval.
The one account-scoped receipt reads back the exact evidence, four proposed facts, zero confirmed facts, and a separate simulated recruiter-owned action proposal.
No action approval, capability execution, effect attempt, effect observation, candidate contact, calendar event, message, ATS, CRM, cookie, history, or unrelated-tab read occurred.
Retention is explicit and enforceable through source-retention.v2 with reviewed_selected_text scope and a returned deadline.
missing_evidence: A candidate-facing notice, access, and deletion route remains outside this synthetic recruiter-only slice.
A governed real-source locator contract remains intentionally unimplemented.
open_questions: What minimum source locator is necessary for future real evidence without turning the audit trail into browsing surveillance?
